maintenance_led.reason: Core analysis, reservoir description, and production enhancement services for new wells and field development, not repair or maintenance of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are oil and gas operators and energy companies, which are private and national oil companies paying for services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own proprietary reservoir description and production services, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Operators can hire other labs and service firms for core analysis and inspection, and the work is discretionary and cyclical.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, since proprietary data and long-term relationships give some stickiness.
